productionSelection.rationale: Direct generated stores bypass checked physical-memory writes and their code-generation tokens. The shipped UEFI composition therefore retains checked callbacks until protected host pages pass the complete ordinary-guest qualification campaign.

regressionIsolation.failure: x86 instructionFetch touches unmapped memory at 0xfffffe8f for 5 bytes
regressionIsolation.diagnosticResult: The current source reached the retained marker when protected host pages and direct JIT writes were disabled together, identifying the coherent checked-callback path retained by this change.

limits: This is a source-bound development baseline, not public release qualification.
It proves the retained UEFI marker and checked-write coherence boundary, not an ordinary installed distribution, desktop, SMP or performance target.
Protected host-page write coherence remains available only as an explicit experiment and is not selected by the production UEFI composition.
